findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "partnership" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_started, get_more_tools, get_reach_options · Private data: book_intro_call, request_offer · Public sink: get_more_tools, get_reach_options, match_package, build_business_case, request_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_started, get_more_tools, get_reach_options · Private data: book_intro_call, request_offer · Public sink: get_more_tools, get_reach_options, match_package, build_business_case, request_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_more_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
